text: 1. Applicants must be in good physical and mental health, with proper moral conduct, friendly to China, between the ages of 18 and 22, and have attained a senior high school diploma.2. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport , meet the conditions set by the Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the PRC .3. Applicants who’s native language is not English should submit the results of TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo or English Proficiency Certificate (90 or above in TOEFL, 6 or above in IELTS,105 or above in Duolingo)
